description: Job Title: 3rd Shift Quality Assurance Analyst (Float Role) Job Description The 3rd Shift Quality Assurance Analyst (Float Role) ensures that all products meet the highest standards of quality and food safety in alignment with industry regulations and internal policies. Working primarily on the evening and overnight shift, this role focuses on auditing, testing, and documentation to maintain compliance with GMP, SQF, HACCP, FDA, and state regulations. The analyst collaborates closely with operations, sanitation, and maintenance teams to support continuous improvement and uphold a strong culture of quality throughout the facility. Responsibilities Perform routine quality assurance and quality control activities to ensure products consistently meet established specifications and standards. Conduct case audits, batch record reviews, and self-inspections to verify compliance with GMP, SQF, HACCP, FDA, and state regulations. Review and verify Certificates of Analysis (COAs) from suppliers to confirm that incoming materials meet required quality and safety criteria. Perform microbiological testing and environmental monitoring to identify potential food safety risks and ensure a hygienic production environment. Monitor and verify critical control points in the production process to maintain HACCP plan compliance and prevent food safety incidents. Document quality findings, maintain accurate quality records, and ensure all quality documentation is complete, organized, and audit-ready. Support and participate in mock recalls and audit preparation activities to strengthen traceability and regulatory compliance. Conduct inspections on the production floor to verify adherence to food safety protocols, sanitation practices, and GMP requirements. Use root cause analysis to investigate nonconformances, quality deviations, and process issues, and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Collaborate with operations, sanitation, and maintenance teams to resolve quality issues and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Communicate quality concerns, test results, and compliance status clearly and professionally to relevant stakeholders. Support responses to internal and external audits, including providing documentation, explanations, and evidence of compliance. Maintain a strong focus on food safety and regulatory requirements in all daily activities and decision-making. Adapt to a float role across different areas or lines as needed, providing quality support wherever demand is highest. Be available to work extended hours, including overtime and occasional weekends, during audits, food safety emergencies, or other critical events. Essential Skills 15 years of experience in quality assurance, quality control, or a related role, combined with a degree in the sciences (such as Biology or a similar discipline), OR at least 5 years of experience in quality within a GMP/FDA-regulated facility. Job Title: QC Microbiology Analyst Job Description The QC Microbiology Analyst performs essential microbiological analyses that ensure product quality and safety within a pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. In this role, you conduct microbiological testing on raw materials, finished products, and environmental samples in accordance with established SOPs and GMP guidelines. You prepare media, maintain cultures, identify microorganisms, perform environmental monitoring, and calibrate laboratory equipment while carefully documenting and analyzing test results. You also contribute to method development, support validation projects, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement in laboratory and quality operations. This position offers strong career development opportunities, exposure to multiple areas of pharmaceutical quality, and the chance to directly support a mission focused on making the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Responsibilities Perform microbiological testing on raw materials, in-process samples, finished products, and environmental samples in accordance with SOPs, GMP, and GLP requirements. Prepare microbiological media and reagents, ensuring accurate formulation, labeling, and sterility. Maintain and handle microbial cultures, including storage, subculturing, and disposal in line with aseptic techniques and safety protocols. Conduct environmental monitoring activities, including sampling of air, surfaces, and personnel, and interpret results against established limits. Execute microbiological assays such as growth promotion testing and microbial identification using approved methods. Calibrate, operate, and perform routine maintenance on laboratory equipment to ensure reliable and accurate test results. Document all laboratory activities and test results clearly and accurately in laboratory notebooks, electronic systems, and quality records. Analyze data, identify trends or deviations, and escalate issues in accordance with quality and compliance procedures. Participate in method development and validation projects to improve or implement microbiological testing procedures. Collaborate with cross-functional teams in Quality Control, Materials Testing, Sampling, Instrument Maintenance, Microbiology, and Research and Development to support overall quality objectives. Support continuous improvement initiatives within the laboratory by suggesting process enhancements and contributing to problem-solving efforts. Follow all safety protocols and use appropriate personal protective equipment, including lab coat, safety glasses, and gloves, while performing laboratory tasks. Maintain a clean, organized, and compliant laboratory workspace that meets regulatory and internal quality standards. Manage workload effectively by prioritizing testing activities to meet project timelines and production schedules.
